headline: As of 2026-10-07: 2,051,498 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 33 of 50 states, D+29.5 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 2,051,498 early/mail ballots cast so far across 33 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+29.5 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (422,252), Florida (350,535), Michigan (252,707).
